rationale: The replication successfully reproduces the paper's central kagome application: three k=0 uniform-precession modes with mutually orthogonal (x,y,z) polarizations, correct frequency ratios matching analytic formulas, and independently confirms the kagome flat band via LSWT. However, the core theoretical contribution—the Onsager coefficient derivation connecting spin pumping to STT for SO(3) order parameters (Eqs. 1-18)—and the full spin-pumping/ISHE transport chain were only structurally verified, not numerically computed end-to-end. Coverage is limited to the kagome application section (~Sec III) while the general theory (Sec II) remains unexercised computationally.
